Me. ARCHIBALD NEILSON, J.P., L.R.C.P.Edin., L.F.P.S.Glasg. 
Glasgow. 
Mr. Archibald Neilson, who died on 19th September, at the 
advanced age of 94 years, was for a great many years a very 
well known figure in the East End of Glasgow. Mr. Neilson 
qualified in 1865, and for many years resided at 10 Sommerville 
Place, where he conducted a busy practice. He took an active 
interest in municipal affairs, and sat in the Town Council for 
several years as one of the representatives of the Fourth Ward, 
becoming a member of several committees in which his profes- 
sional knowledge was valuable. He was kindly by nature, and 
always ready with a word of encouragement for a junior 
practitioner.
